name: Donut
description: The ring. The shell closed into a ring where the emitter chamber used to be, and the suit was built around what was left: a large hollow port in the middle of the chest, open straight through to the dark suit behind it, ringed in dark red, with the dead core moved out to the rim off to one side, the way it always was. A row of husk quills runs down the spine from the collar to the belt, standing off the back; a short cowl is drawn over the helmet; and on the near forearm a launcher bracket holds three wing blades loaded flat — Drifter membranes on bone frames, thrown to bounce from body to body — so the hands stay free. A pouch hangs at the far hip. Two dead feelers curve back from under the cowl. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: a thief's stance, weight forward: a shallow breath, the quills on the back rising with the shoulders, the loaded blades on the forearm glinting as the arm hangs and swings a little

walk.description: a quick stride with the near arm swinging low and the loaded bracket riding it, the quills on the back rocking, the pouch bouncing at the hip
